import os; p='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-3/play/users/u040/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f77f75e9.py'; os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    color = next(v for row in grid for v in row if v not in (0, 3))
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r,c in cells]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-(r1-r0)):
        for c in range(w-(c1-c0)):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr,dc in shape):
                for dr,dc in shape:
                    out[r+dr][c+dc] = color
    return out
'''
